definition: כּוּתָה , כּוּת proper name, of a location whence king of Assyria (Sargon) transported colonists into Northern Israel, מִכּוּתָה 2Kgs 17:4 , אַנְשֵׁיכֿוּת v 2Kgs 17:30 Babylonian Kûtû, Kûtê , modern Tel-Ibrahim, approximately 20 miles northeast from Babylon, see COT 2Kgs 17:24 Dl Par 217 M-A JBL 1892, xi. 169 .
